items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I worked in the movie studios way back in the early Forties... with Hazel Scott and Lee Young... Lee and I were featured with Hazel Scott in that particular picture

ctx.x: Well, that's what I had heard for a long time. Then Marshall Royal told me that he'd worked in the movie studios. But Buddy worked in the television and radio studios.
Yeah, well, I worked in the movie studios way back in the early Forties. I was reading in one of your books here, I Dood It, that was in 1943, with Hazel Scott and Lee Young...
